package.name: valid8_cell_control
package.description:
Valid8 Robot Cell Control Package
Contains the ros2_control enabled URDF and launch files for: - UR Robot Driver integration - Controlled robot description with hardware interfaces - Robot state publisher launch file - Start robot launch file
Based on Universal Robots ROS 2 custom workcell tutorial: https://docs.universal-robots.com/Universal_Robots_ROS_Documentation/doc/ur_tutorials/
